propositions: Commit d9e0f0e733 introduced unconditional top-level imports of git_adapter in _advisory_lock and _ref_lock that break standalone by-path module loading when rebar_reconciler package is intentionally absent.
The bridge preview contention test fails at _advisory_lock._lock_remote import because __package__ is empty and find_spec(rebar_reconciler) returns None in standalone execution context.

Both _advisory_lock and _ref_lock must load git_adapter via lazy_load("rebar_reconciler.git_adapter", "git_adapter.py") to restore standalone execution while preserving the canonical sys.modules key shared with package-context importers.
The pre-d9 parent commit successfully acquired and released ref locks in the same standalone context, confirming the regression is specific to the unconditional imports introduced in d9e0f0e733.
